description: Every global Fire token with its type, tier, group, Ember default and Facet role. GENERATED by scripts/build-contract.mjs from fire/tokens.css, fire/typefaces.css and fire/js/theme.js; do not edit by hand.

tiers.input: Set by a theme record (contract/theme.schema.json): the palette colour inputs, the three font families and the dial variables.
tiers.scale: A step of a scale: its value may change, but steps are not added or renamed.
tiers.derived: Computed by Fire from the palette; never authored.

tokens.name: --fd-font-sans
tokens.default: "Geist", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: --fd-font-mono
tokens.default: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tokens.name: --fd-font-display
tokens.default: "Geist", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

default.light: inset 0 6px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.02), inset 0 0.75px 0.75px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.02), inset 0 0.25px 0.25px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04)
default.dark: inset 0 6px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2), inset 0 0.75px 0.75px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2), inset 0 0.25px 0.25px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3)

tokens.name: --fd-eyebrow-font
tokens.default: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tokens.name: --fd-section-label-font
tokens.default: "Geist", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

facet.description: Facet colour roles: each role, the token that fills it, and Ember's opaque value in each mode (muted is --fd-text-3 laid over --fd-bg). Facet's accent role is left to Facet.
